svg.text: FinLedger — Double-Entry Payments Ledger on AWS (EKS Fargate)
PRIVATE SUBNETS — AZ-a + AZ-b (Fargate profiles reject any public subnet)
EKS CLUSTER · FARGATE-ONLY — 1 pod = 1 micro-VM, no EC2 nodes
ESO webhook moved off port 10250 — Fargate reserves it internally for kubelet emulation
ADOT Collector → pod CPU/mem · cloudwatch-exporter → SQS queue depth · prometheus-adapter → HPA external metric
node-exporter disabled — DaemonSets unsupported on Fargate · Container Insights add-on unsupported, hence ADOT
namespace: finledger · 5 Pod Disruption Budgets (minAvailable:1) · probes tuned to measured startup time
dedicated KMS key · private subnet · SG: pods :5432 only
every transfer = 2 balanced rows, one atomic transaction
idempotency-key fast path — skips the DB on hot retries
NOT the source of truth: the UNIQUE constraint is
cached only AFTER commit — never before
losing this node degrades latency, never correctness
fan-out — every consumer sees every event
ESO syncs live — 0 plaintext K8s secrets

Python 3.12 · FastAPI · Docker · EKS Fargate · RDS PostgreSQL · ElastiCache · SNS/SQS + DLQs · Terraform · GitHub Actions OIDC · Trivy · Prometheus · Grafana · ADOT · External Secrets Operator · KMS · IRSA · k6
Outbox Pattern for exactly-once publishing · DB-level UNIQUE constraint for idempotency · chaos-tested PDBs and Multi-AZ failover · 0 long-lived AWS credentials
